description: Jolly Lobby Track opens showing the main visitor management screen with an extensive visitor database containing records from December 2025 through January 2026. Generate a comprehensive visitor report for the month of December 2025 (December 1-31, 2025). The report should include all visitors who signed in during that period. Export or save the report to a file on the desktop. The report should show visitor names, companies, hosts visited, dates, and sign-in/sign-out times. Navigate to the Reports section of Lobby Track, set the date range to December 2025, and export the results.
